name: scroll-based-velocity
title: Scroll Based Velocity
description: Rows of big text scrolling endlessly in opposite directions; bursts of speed (authored, like a scroll) make them race and can flip their direction.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.scrollBasedVelocity(q(".r1"), tl, 0, { baseVelocity: 20, direction: 1, scroll: burst, hold: 8 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: scroll: [[t, px/s], ...] relative to `at`, linear between keys (a page scrolled at 1000 px/s gives factor 5: six times the speed). Without keys the rows run at the base speed. Side fades as upstream's demo: 1/4 of the width.
moworks.titleVi: Hàng chữ lớn chạy ngược chiều, tăng tốc
